target_moa.text: Efgartigimod is a human IgG1 antibody fragment engineered to bind the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn); by blocking FcRn it inhibits FcRn-mediated recycling of IgG, shortening IgG half-life and reducing circulating IgG including pathogenic autoantibodies

citations.quote: Efgartigimod is a human IgG1 antibody fragment engineered to bind with neonatal FcRn, resulting in the reduction of circulating IgG, including autoantibodies.

When bound to the FcRn, efgartigimod blocks binding of IgG and inhibits the FcRn-mediated recycling of IgG. Inhibition of this recycling process results in shorter half-life of plasma IgG and, thus, lower plasma IgG levels.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=10%) are respiratory tract infections, headache, and urinary tract infection.
